mapper.sql: u.user_id AS id,u.lgn_id AS "loginId",u.user_nm AS name,u.email_addr AS email,u.tel_no AS phone,u.bsn_part_id AS "basePartId",u.dev_id AS "developerId",u.user_stts_cd AS status,u.last_lgn_at AS "lastLoginAt",u.rsgn_dt AS "resignationDate",u.rsgn_dt > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS "resignationScheduled",(u.mfa_yn='Y' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.admin_yn='Y' AND r.use_yn='Y')) AS "mfaRequired"

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_part p WHERE p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.bsn_part_id=CAST(#{partId} AS bigint))
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role r WHERE r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id=CAST(#{roleId} AS bigint))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.user_info u ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_id=#{id}
SELECT role_id FROM sys.user_role WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY role_id
SELECT bsn_part_id FROM sys.user_part WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY bsn_part_id
SELECT prj_id FROM sys.user_prj WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY prj_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.user_info user_nm=#{name},email_addr=#{email}, tel_no=#{phone},bsn_part_id=#{basePartId}, dev_id=#{developerId}, user_stts_cd=#{status}, lgn_fail_cnt=0,lock_at=NULL, rsgn_dt=CAST(#{resignationDate} AS date), updated_at=#{now},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE user_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: role_id AS id,role_nm AS name,role_desc AS description,use_yn AS "useYn",data_scope_cd AS "dataScope",snstv_inq_yn='Y' AS "sensitiveInquiry",part_std_chg_auth_yn='Y' AS "partStandardChange",admin_yn='Y' AS admin,bltin_yn='Y' AS "builtIn"
mapper.select: INSERT INTO sys.role(role_nm,role_desc,use_yn,data_scope_cd,snstv_inq_yn,part_std_chg_auth_yn,admin_yn,copy_role_id,created_by) VALUES(#{name},#{description},#{useYn},#{dataScope},CASE WHEN #{sensitiveInquiry} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{partStandardChange} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{admin} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{copyRoleId},#{actor}) RETURNING role_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.role SET role_nm=#{name},role_desc=#{description},use_yn=#{useYn},data_scope_cd=#{dataScope},snstv_inq_yn=CASE WHEN #{sensitiveInquiry} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,part_std_chg_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{partStandardChange} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,admin_yn=CASE WHEN #{admin} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,updated_at=#{now},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE role_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.role_menu_auth(role_id,menu_id,inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn) SELECT #{id},menu_id,inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn FROM sys.role_menu_auth WHERE role_id=#{copyRoleId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS "menuId",m.scrn_id AS "screenId",m.menu_nm AS name,m.upr_menu_id AS "parentId", COALESCE(a.inq_auth_yn,'N')='Y' AS inq,COALESCE(a.reg_auth_yn,'N')='Y' AS reg,COALESCE(a.mdfcn_auth_yn,'N')='Y' AS mdfcn,COALESCE(a.del_auth_yn,'N')='Y' AS del,COALESCE(a.upld_auth_yn,'N')='Y' AS upld,COALESCE(a.dwnld_auth_yn,'N')='Y' AS dwnld,COALESCE(a.cnfrm_auth_yn,'N')='Y' AS cnfrm FROM sys.menu m LEFT JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.menu_id=m.menu_id AND a.role_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.sort_seq,m.menu_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.role_menu_auth(role_id,menu_id,inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn,updated_by,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{menuId},CASE WHEN #{inq} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{reg} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{mdfcn} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{del} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{upld} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{dwnld} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{cnfrm} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor},#{now}) ON CONFLICT(role_id,menu_id) DO UPDATE SET inq_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn=EXCLUDED.cnfrm_auth_yn,updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.sql: menu_id AS id,upr_menu_id AS "parentId",menu_nm AS name,scrn_id AS "screenId",icon_nm AS icon,sort_seq AS "sortOrder",use_yn AS "useYn",mbl_expsr_yn='Y' AS "mobileVisible"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.menu ORDER BY sort_seq,menu_id

INSERT INTO sys.menu(menu_nm,scrn_id,icon_nm,upr_menu_id,sort_seq,use_yn,mbl_expsr_yn,created_by) VALUES(#{name},#{screenId},#{icon},#{parentId},#{sortOrder},#{useYn},CASE WHEN #{mobileVisible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor}) RETURNING menu_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.menu SET menu_nm=#{name},icon_nm=#{icon},upr_menu_id=#{parentId},sort_seq=#{sortOrder},use_yn=#{useYn},mbl_expsr_yn=CASE WHEN #{mobileVisible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,updated_at=#{now},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE menu_id=#{id}

where.if: AND created_at < CAST(#{to} AS date)+INTERVAL '1 day'

mapper.select: SELECT acs_hist_id AS id,user_id AS "userId",created_at AS "occurredAt",acs_ty_cd AS action,acs_ty_cd NOT IN ('LOGIN_FAIL','AUTH_DENIED') AS success,scrn_id AS "screenId",obj_desc AS target,ip_addr AS ip FROM sys.acs_hist ORDER BY created_at DESC,acs_hist_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' WHERE revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT txt_val='Y' FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id='NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_ENABLED' AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1),false)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.oprt_std(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,txt_val,created_by) VALUES('NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_ENABLED',#{month},'업무 알림 메일',CASE WHEN #{businessEmailEnabled} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET txt_val=EXCLUDED.txt_val
